instruction: Studio photograph, full shot. In an indoor studio with draped beige curtains, a shirtless man in black pants (R2) stands facing forward, supporting a woman in a beige sports bra and black shorts (R1). The woman leans forward in a dynamic pose with her left leg extended back and right leg bent. The shirtless man holds her left thigh with his right hand and her upper arm with his left hand. No bystanders are present. Soft studio lighting casts gentle shadows on the neutral fabric background.
